images.description: Hand-drawn treasure map on aged/burned parchment paper

details.background: Golden/tan aged paper with creases and wear marks
details.compass_rose: Decorative compass rose in bottom right corner
details.path: Dashed line path starting from an arrow marker, making several turns, ending at a destination point
details.markings: Various small marks and symbols along the path
details.overall_shape: Square parchment with irregular burned edges

map_analysis.start_indicator: Black arrow/pointer shape in upper portion
map_analysis.path_type: Dashed line with multiple direction changes
map_analysis.end_indicator: Path terminates at a specific point
map_analysis.path_turns: Multiple turns - appears to follow a specific route

notes: This is the author's hand-drawn treasure map - the primary clue for finding the Appalachian Footpath treasure box. The author stated this is his 'first real treasure map' and that following it leads to the treasure location 'somewhere along The Appalachian Trail.'
